summary: Obfuscated loader fetches and eval's unpinned remote JavaScript from jsDelivr
details: index.js is heavily obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style string-array with rotating decoder) and its exported functions (loadEncryptString, encryptStringAdmin, decryptStringAdmin) fetch a JavaScript payload from an unpinned jsDelivr URL resolving to the encryptstringadmincore package and execute it via `new Function('CryptoJS', code +...)`. The loader only accepts payloads containing the marker string `__esaCore`, and the destination URL is assembled from decoded string-array fragments rather than appearing as a plain literal. The pointer is mutable (no version pin, no integrity/hash check), so whichever bytes the publisher of encryptstringadmincore serves at call time are executed in the consumer application's context. Obfuscation in the loader hides the fetch-and-Function-eval control flow.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
